W: How were your deliveries? M: Not bad, except at that new residential building on South Street. I had to call them on my phone to come pick up their food. At first, I tried to call on the building intercom, but it's still broken. W: You're not the first to say that. Last week, a customer called to complain that their food was cold by the time they found it. M: Maybe we just can't make deliveries there until the landlord fixes the intercom system. W: I'm going to update the instructions on our mobile app telling customers to meet us at the building's front door. Let's see if that helps.

W: We're getting close to the time of year when we need to begin planning our Theater in the Park series for the summer. We have lots of decisions to make about shows, dates, and performers. M: You're right. I'll set up a meeting for this month. You know, I had an idea. Why don't we invite community residents to volunteer to help with building sets, painting, and setting up the stage? W: We could, but I don't know if we'll be able to use volunteers this year. We'll need approval to start that kind of program. It'll take time. Let's check into that for next year.

M: Back to our podcast with special guest Kimberly Stuart, who's currently advising our city on business development projects. Before the break, we promised to address the decline of shopping downtown. W: Yes—and it's been the worst at the kind of stores that sell unique items like antiques and jewelry. These items have always been purchased at brick-and-mortar stores but are now being purchased mostly online. M: So, do those stores have a future? W: I think they do, especially if we make a point of organizing live community activities downtown, such as concerts or festivals. When people walk around town, they are likely to browse at stores—and make purchases.

M: Our company has seen a huge spike in sales ever since it launched the rebate program for customers. With the rebate, customers get money back. And they're telling their friends, increasing our sales. W: Yes. The rebate's been great for our company because now more homeowners have an incentive to install solar panels on their properties, since they're rewarded for the electricity their solar panels produce. But our technicians can't keep up with the high demand. M: You're right. I'm planning to hire more technicians. I've already received some résumés from potential candidates.

M: Fernanda, I was just looking at the company calendar, and I noticed that the national electronics trade show is coming up soon. W: Oh, that's right! It'll be a great opportunity for us to showcase the product that we've been developing—our new robotic vacuum cleaner. M: We'll need to decide who we want to send to represent our company at the trade show. W: Well, I know just the right person—Kavi. Kavi does a good job of clearly explaining highly technical concepts in a way that everyone can understand.

M: Dr. Fuentes, sorry to interrupt. Do you have a minute? W: Yes. My nine o'clock dental cleaning patient just canceled. M: I know you're looking for a new receptionist. I'd like to recommend someone for the position. W: Oh. Who do you have in mind? M: Well, a former colleague of mine has just moved back to town. Her name's Kelly Graham, and she has several years of experience. W: OK. Could you tell Kelly to send me her résumé? I'd be happy to look it over.

M1: Ms. Gao? I'm Hector, and this is my colleague Sergey. Thanks for meeting with us. W: It's a pleasure to meet you both. How can I help you? M2: We're making some training videos for our client, FiveStar Industries. M1: We found your advertisement in a trade publication. We need someone to choose appropriate filming sites at FiveStar's factories, and it said you have lots of experience scouting for industrial locations. W: Sure. I'd want to start by touring their factories. Can you schedule a time for me to do that next week? M2: Yes, I'll call them today to arrange it.

M: Our engineering firm has been asked to cut the corporate travel budget by twenty percent, but it won't be easy. The engineering consultants have to travel to meet with clients. W: Right, and they often travel on short notice. Flight arrangements made at the last minute are expensive, especially for nonstop flights. It would be cheaper if they took connecting flights. M: Yes, but that can take a lot of time. W: True. Maybe we can make up for the cost of the flights by economizing on hotels. Let's look into that.

M1: Thanks for meeting with us, Ms. Azuma. This is Scott Ajibade, one of our senior project managers. M2: I admire your work, Ms. Azuma. W: Thank you. I was surprised by your invitation. I typically design jewelry, but your company's known for making computers and mobile phones. M1: Scott's team is currently working on a smartwatch. But there's a lot of competition, as you know. M2: We're hoping you can create a fresh design that will help our product stand out. W: Do you already have an idea of what the watch should look like, or are we starting from scratch? M2: I have some preliminary sketches we can look at, but none of them seem quite right.

W: Hi. I'd like to purchase some new carpeting. It's for the waiting room at my hair salon. M: We have many different styles. Are you looking for something different? W: Well, we get a lot of customers walking through, and our current carpeting is a light color. M: No matter what color you get, all our carpets are durable and can take high amounts of foot traffic. For businesses like yours, I recommend placing a protective mat near the door. W: That's a good idea. M: Also, I offer free cleaning services for a year for all purchases.

M: I really need this coffee break. My morning meeting with my client was really challenging. W: What were you discussing? M: The project schedule. They asked us to provide the prototype design to them three weeks earlier than originally planned. W: Well. Then today's cup is my treat. Which one would you like? M: That's so nice of you! I'll go with the White Cloud Coffee. I like a little milk in mine. W: Good choice. So, I have some news to share with you. Did you hear about David? M: No, what's going on? W: Apparently, he's planning to retire next month.

M: This is Bradley from Windows Galore. How can I help you? W: Hello! I'd like to have screens added to my windows at home. I was wondering if you would be available to stop by and take a look. I live at 42 West Third Street, by the way. M: OK—that's not far. Let me see. I could come any morning this week. W: How about in the afternoon? M: Hmm. I could reschedule my Tuesday afternoon appointment. I'll check and get back to you—I have your number now. And your name is? W: Hoffman—Claudia Hoffman. Thank you. Talk to you soon.

M: Ms. Kwon, thank you for sending me to the upcoming robotics conference. I didn't expect an opportunity like this so soon after being hired here. W: It's important for you to be familiar with current robot designs. There are always new trends and technologies coming out, and I want you to stay ahead of developments in our industry. M: I agree. Plus, it'll give me the chance to introduce myself to potential clients. W: Oh, about that: here's a handout I provide to all new hires. It includes some helpful tips—especially this one. Do you have your business cards yet? M: Hmm. I haven't received them, but I'll call the printer today for an update.

Crew, please stop working on that truck repair for a second. Many of you complained about how slow and hard it is to use the car lift, so I purchased a new one and it was delivered this morning! It can lift much heavier vehicles, and it's faster. The only problem is we're missing the bottles of hydraulic fluid that were supposed to be included in the shipment. So, we're stuck using the old car lift for a few more days. Oh, and one more thing—when talking to customers, please remember to mention that we're now offering a discount on oil changes if they schedule a vehicle inspection with us.

As you know, we've had an extremely successful fourth quarter selling desks and chairs to our corporate clients on the West Coast. In fact, we've done so well that we're planning to give ten percent of this month's profits to a local charity in December. They have a great reputation for teaching computer skills to children for free. If you'd like to see a video clip of our CEO talking about this initiative, just visit our social media site.

Welcome to Impact Unlocked, the podcast for businesses wanting to streamline their operations with new technology. In today's episode, I'll talk about how to raise money by leveraging social media applications to get donations. I could focus on specific applications, but these things are constantly changing. Instead, I'll speak generally about how these types of applications can help you connect with potential donors. Some organizations keep using the same familiar fund-raising strategies. I see this often, but it's important to also incorporate the latest approaches.

As the company president, I'm excited to share that we've sold a record number of home appliances for two years in a row, and I'd like to reward your hard work. First, everyone will be eligible for a one-time monetary bonus. Your supervisor will speak with you about how it'll be calculated and when you'll receive it. Also, I'd like to offer more flexibility in your schedule, so all employees will be permitted to work remotely twice a week. You'll just need to note those days on your calendar, so everyone knows where you are.

I called this meeting today because I wanted to talk about changes to how our company hires new employees. It came to my attention that some people were confused when reading about these new hiring policies in the latest company newsletter. I posted a link in the meeting invitation to this information, and I asked you to bring your laptops so that you can follow along on your own screen. After we review the policies, you can see Sumit in the back of the room if you'd like a printed copy. He has several of them.

As head of the product design team, I have the sales results from the last quarter, and they're disappointing. It's clear that consumers are no longer interested in the types of toys and games we've been producing. My guess is that people are getting tired of noisy, blinking electronics. We have a lot of work to do. There's a new trend toward outdoor toys and games, where people can be physically active. I've already come up with some prototypes of new games. I brought a few of them, and now I'll show you how they work.

Hello. You've reached Ji-Soo Yoon at the visitor center of the Pine Valley Nature Preserve. I am currently out of the office. Please be aware that visitor access to the park will be limited during the month of March while our facilities are undergoing renovations. If you are calling for information about helping to maintain our hiking trails, please refer to the volunteer page on our Web site. We welcome the assistance of motivated individuals. For all other inquiries, please leave a message after the tone.

Today, I'll be interviewing the owners of Salazar Olive Oil, one of the best in California for the past two decades. Now—if you're hearing about this olive oil for the first time, you're not alone. The Salazar family has kept the operation small. I'm interested in discussing their business philosophy as well as their new project: an olive oil tasting class on their farm. You'll find out how to register during the interview so you can sign up!

Welcome to the Abingdon Transit Station. Please be advised that the Circle Route bus is not currently stopping at the station entrance because of some street resurfacing work. A temporary bus stop has been set up around the corner in front of the post office. Signs are posted directing you to the new stop. Bus timetables will be affected by the change in the route. Use the Abingdon Transit mobile phone app to view live updates for when the next bus is due.

Hello, everyone! We're happy to announce that the February continuing education workshops here at the community center were very successful. Thank you for working so hard to make sure they ran smoothly. Every workshop was completely full. In fact, we had to create a waiting list for the Monday night workshop. Beginning in March, we'll offer that same workshop on Fridays. Now, many participants complained about the lack of vending machines in the building. Bianca will be contacting vending services next week to ask about pricing.

Delta City Art Museum—Current Exhibits

The Impressionists, May 1–June 30, Main Gallery
Paintings from this well-known nineteenth-century art movement will be on display, including works by both famous and lesser-known artists.

Native American Pottery, May 15–July 16, Shawe Memorial Gallery
Visitors to this exhibit will learn about the wide range of pottery-related techniques developed and utilized by Indigenous peoples across North America.

Classical Greece and Beyond, May 22–August 21, Techtmann Gallery
This exhibit features statues of human subjects from classical Greece, along with modern pieces influenced by the classical style.

Artists of Delta City, Permanent Exhibit, Zhang Atrium
This popular exhibit showcases contemporary works by local artists in various media, including oil and watercolor paintings, photographs, fiber art, and mixed-media works. Although the exhibit is ongoing, individual pieces are displayed on a rotating basis and are on view for a limited time only.

To:	Delta City Art Museum <info@deltacityartmuseum.org>
From:	Lorelei Desnoyers <lorelei.desnoyers@klarsenuniversity.edu>
Date:	May 2
Subject:	Inquiry

Good morning,

I am a new art instructor at Klarsen University. One of my colleagues told me that the Delta City Art Museum provides tours for local art students. I am interested in bringing my Art 103 class to view and sketch some of the pieces you have on display. Since Art 103 focuses on studying and drawing the human form, the statues will be getting most of our attention. However, I'm hoping that we could have a brief tour of the whole museum before we begin our work. Please let me know if this could be arranged.

Thank you in advance for your assistance!

Lorelei Desnoyers

School of Art & Design

Klarsen University

504-555-0177

To:	Lorelei Desnoyers <lorelei.desnoyers@klarsenuniversity.edu>
From:	Jocelyn Grady <jgrady@deltacityartmuseum.org>
Date:	May 3
Subject:	RE: Inquiry

Dear Ms. Desnoyers,

Thank you for your e-mail. Your colleague was correct: the museum does indeed provide that service. We would likely schedule you on a Tuesday, since that is typically our least busy day. I have forwarded your message to our office of public programs. A staff member will contact you by phone with more details.

Please note that the use of paints, including watercolors, is prohibited in all museum galleries. Pencils and charcoal are permitted, although visitors are asked to take care not to leave smudges on museum surfaces. We also allow photography and video recording as long as patrons are considerate of other visitors.

We are grateful for your interest in Delta City Art Museum and look forward to hosting your class.

Jocelyn Grady

Information and Community Outreach

Delta City Art Museum

https://www.sleepytimehotel.com/reviews

My stay at the Sleepy Time Hotel was fantastic. Initially, I was worried I could not get to the hotel easily from Johnstown, where I had just finished an exhilarating three-day professional conference. The hotel Web site is not crystal clear about transportation options. Since I am not familiar with this part of the country, I e-mailed the hotel, and someone responded immediately. Ultimately, it was easy to get to Charlesville. First, I took the 4:05 P.M. train out of Johnstown. Once I arrived at Charlesville Central Station, I rode the elevator to the basement, where the light-rail train platforms are located. I then boarded a light-rail train and rode it to the station directly across the street from the hotel. Apparently, the Charlesville light-rail system is relatively new. Keep in mind that there are no restaurants near the hotel, but there is a small grocery store around the corner. So I was able to purchase some food and have a picnic on the beach. Overall, this small hotel with lovely, bright rooms is a perfect escape from city life. I felt so relaxed when I finally returned to my office and got back to work.

Jongwoo Cho, posted on August 26

The hotel Web site is not crystal clear about transportation options. Since I am not familiar with this part of the country, I e-mailed the hotel, and someone responded immediately. Ultimately, it was easy to get to Charlesville. First, I took the 4:05 P.M. train out of Johnstown. Once I arrived at Charlesville Central Station, I rode the elevator to the basement, where the light-rail train platforms are located. I then boarded a light-rail train and rode it to the station directly across the street from the hotel. Apparently, the Charlesville light-rail system is relatively new. Keep in mind that there are no restaurants near the hotel, but there is a small grocery store around the corner. So I was able to purchase some food and have a picnic on the beach. Overall, this small hotel with lovely, bright rooms is a perfect escape from city life. I felt so relaxed when I finally returned to my office and got back to work.

71. - Dẫn chứng: "please stop working on that truck repair for a second." (xin hãy ngừng sửa chữa chiếc xe tải đó một chút.)
- Paraphrase: truck repair (sửa chữa xe tải) = At a car repair shop (Tại một cửa hàng sửa chữa xe hơi).

questions.stem: What problem does the speaker mention?

options.text: A training manual should be updated.

questions.explanation:
72. - Dẫn chứng: "The only problem is we're missing the bottles of hydraulic fluid that were supposed to be included in the shipment." (Vấn đề duy nhất là chúng ta bị thiếu các chai dầu thủy lực đáng lẽ phải được bao gồm trong lô hàng.)
- Paraphrase: missing the bottles of hydraulic fluid (thiếu các chai dầu thủy lực) = Some supplies are missing (Một số nguồn cung cấp bị thiếu).

questions.stem: What should the listeners remind customers about?
questions.explanation:
73. - Dẫn chứng: "please remember to mention that we're now offering a discount on oil changes if they schedule a vehicle inspection with us." (xin hãy nhớ đề cập rằng chúng ta hiện đang cung cấp giảm giá thay dầu nếu họ đặt lịch kiểm tra xe với chúng ta.)
- Paraphrase: offering a discount on oil changes (cung cấp giảm giá thay dầu) = A promotional offer (Một ưu đãi quảng cáo).

questions.stem: What does the company sell?
questions.explanation:
74. - Dẫn chứng: "selling desks and chairs to our corporate clients on the West Coast." (bán bàn ghế cho khách hàng doanh nghiệp của chúng ta ở Bờ Tây.)
- Paraphrase: selling desks and chairs (bán bàn ghế) = Office furniture (Nội thất văn phòng).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say will happen in December?

options.text: Some temporary staff will be hired.
Some profits will be donated to a charity.

questions.explanation:
75. - Dẫn chứng: "we're planning to give ten percent of this month's profits to a local charity in December." (chúng ta đang lên kế hoạch quyên góp mười phần trăm lợi nhuận tháng này cho một tổ chức từ thiện địa phương vào tháng Mười Hai.)
- Paraphrase: give ten percent of this month's profits to a local charity (quyên góp mười phần trăm lợi nhuận tháng này cho một tổ chức từ thiện địa phương) = Some profits will be donated to a charity (Một số lợi nhuận sẽ được quyên góp cho một tổ chức từ thiện).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what can the listeners find on a social media site?
questions.explanation:
76. - Dẫn chứng: "If you'd like to see a video clip of our CEO talking about this initiative, just visit our social media site." (Nếu bạn muốn xem một đoạn video về CEO của chúng ta nói về sáng kiến này, chỉ cần truy cập trang truyền thông xã hội của chúng ta.)
- Paraphrase: video clip (đoạn video) = A video (Một video).

questions.stem: What is the episode mainly about?
questions.explanation:
77. - Dẫn chứng: "In today's episode, I'll talk about how to raise money by leveraging social media applications to get donations." (Trong tập hôm nay, tôi sẽ nói về cách gây quỹ bằng cách tận dụng các ứng dụng truyền thông xã hội để nhận quyên góp.)
- Paraphrase: raise money (gây quỹ) = Fund-raising (Gây quỹ).

questions.stem: What does the speaker mean when he says, “these things are constantly changing”?

options.text: He questions the value of an investment.

questions.explanation:
78. - Dẫn chứng: "I could focus on specific applications, but these things are constantly changing. Instead, I'll speak generally about how these types of applications can help you connect with potential donors." (Tôi có thể tập trung vào các ứng dụng cụ thể, nhưng những thứ này liên tục thay đổi. Thay vào đó, tôi sẽ nói chung về cách những loại ứng dụng này có thể giúp bạn kết nối với các nhà tài trợ tiềm năng.)
- Paraphrase: these things are constantly changing (những thứ này liên tục thay đổi) = Some information will be excluded (Một số thông tin sẽ bị loại trừ).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say is important for organizations to do?
questions.explanation:
79. - Dẫn chứng: "Some organizations keep using the same familiar fund-raising strategies. I see this often, but it's important to also incorporate the latest approaches." (Một số tổ chức tiếp tục sử dụng các chiến lược gây quỹ quen thuộc. Tôi thường thấy điều này, nhưng điều quan trọng là cũng phải kết hợp các phương pháp tiếp cận mới nhất.)
- Paraphrase: using the same familiar fund-raising strategies... incorporate the latest approaches (sử dụng các chiến lược gây quỹ quen thuộc... kết hợp các phương pháp tiếp cận mới nhất) = Use familiar and current strategies (Sử dụng các chiến lược quen thuộc và hiện tại).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say the company sells?
questions.explanation:
80. - Dẫn chứng: "we've sold a record number of home appliances for two years in a row" (chúng ta đã bán được số lượng thiết bị gia dụng kỷ lục trong hai năm liên tiếp)
- Paraphrase: home appliances (thiết bị gia dụng) = Home appliances (Thiết bị gia dụng).

questions.stem: What will the listeners discuss with their supervisors?
questions.explanation:
81. - Dẫn chứng: "everyone will be eligible for a one-time monetary bonus. Your supervisor will speak with you about how it'll be calculated and when you'll receive it." (mọi người sẽ đủ điều kiện nhận một khoản tiền thưởng một lần. Người giám sát của bạn sẽ nói chuyện với bạn về cách nó sẽ được tính toán và khi nào bạn sẽ nhận được nó.)
- Paraphrase: a one-time monetary bonus (một khoản tiền thưởng một lần) = A financial bonus (Một khoản tiền thưởng tài chính).

questions.stem: How will the company offer more flexibility?

options.text: By allowing employees to switch assignments

questions.explanation:
82. - Dẫn chứng: "all employees will be permitted to work remotely twice a week." (tất cả nhân viên sẽ được phép làm việc từ xa hai lần một tuần.)
- Paraphrase: permitted to work remotely (được phép làm việc từ xa) = permitting remote work (cho phép làm việc từ xa).

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the meeting?
questions.explanation:
83. - Dẫn chứng: "I called this meeting today because I wanted to talk about changes to how our company hires new employees." (Tôi triệu tập cuộc họp này hôm nay vì tôi muốn nói về những thay đổi trong cách công ty chúng ta tuyển dụng nhân viên mới.)
- Paraphrase: talk about changes to how our company hires new employees (nói về những thay đổi trong cách công ty chúng ta tuyển dụng nhân viên mới) = review hiring policies (xem xét các chính sách tuyển dụng).

questions.stem: What did the speaker ask the listeners to bring to the meeting?
questions.explanation:
84. - Dẫn chứng: "I asked you to bring your laptops so that you can follow along on your own screen." (Tôi đã yêu cầu bạn mang máy tính xách tay để bạn có thể theo dõi trên màn hình của mình.)
- Paraphrase: bring your laptops (mang máy tính xách tay của bạn) = A laptop computer (Một máy tính xách tay).

questions.stem: Why might some of the listeners look for Sumit?

options.text: To check the status of a request

questions.explanation:
85. - Dẫn chứng: "you can see Sumit in the back of the room if you'd like a printed copy." (bạn có thể gặp Sumit ở phía sau phòng nếu bạn muốn một bản in.)
- Paraphrase: printed copy (bản in) = get a document (lấy một tài liệu).

questions.stem: What did the speaker recently receive?
questions.explanation:
86. - Dẫn chứng: "I have the sales results from the last quarter, and they're disappointing." (Tôi có kết quả bán hàng từ quý trước, và chúng thật đáng thất vọng.)
- Paraphrase: sales results (kết quả bán hàng) = Sales results (Kết quả bán hàng).

questions.stem: What does the speaker mean when he says, “We have a lot of work to do”?

options.text: A job opening will be posted soon.

questions.explanation:
87. - Dẫn chứng: "My guess is that people are getting tired of noisy, blinking electronics. We have a lot of work to do." (Dự đoán của tôi là mọi người đang chán ngấy các thiết bị điện tử ồn ào, nhấp nháy. Chúng ta có rất nhiều việc phải làm.)
- Paraphrase: We have a lot of work to do (Chúng ta có rất nhiều việc phải làm) = A change is necessary (Một sự thay đổi là cần thiết).

questions.stem: What will the speaker do next?
questions.explanation:
88. - Dẫn chứng: "I brought a few of them, and now I'll show you how they work." (Tôi đã mang một vài cái trong số đó, và bây giờ tôi sẽ cho các bạn thấy chúng hoạt động như thế nào.)
- Paraphrase: show you how they work (cho các bạn thấy chúng hoạt động như thế nào) = Give a demonstration (Thực hiện một buổi trình diễn).

questions.stem: Where does the speaker work?
questions.explanation:
89. - Dẫn chứng: "You've reached Ji-Soo Yoon at the visitor center of the Pine Valley Nature Preserve." (Bạn đã gọi đến Ji-Soo Yoon tại trung tâm du khách của Khu bảo tồn Thiên nhiên Pine Valley.)
- Paraphrase: Pine Valley Nature Preserve (Khu bảo tồn Thiên nhiên Pine Valley) = At a park (Tại một công viên).

questions.stem: What will happen in March?
questions.explanation:
90. - Dẫn chứng: "visitor access to the park will be limited during the month of March while our facilities are undergoing renovations." (việc khách truy cập vào công viên sẽ bị hạn chế trong tháng Ba trong khi các cơ sở của chúng tôi đang được cải tạo.)
- Paraphrase: undergoing renovations (đang được cải tạo) = Renovations will take place (Việc cải tạo sẽ diễn ra).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say can be found online?
questions.explanation:
91. - Dẫn chứng: "If you are calling for information about helping to maintain our hiking trails, please refer to the volunteer page on our Web site." (Nếu bạn gọi để hỏi thông tin về việc giúp duy trì các đường mòn đi bộ đường dài của chúng tôi, vui lòng tham khảo trang tình nguyện trên trang Web của chúng tôi.)
- Paraphrase: volunteer page on our Web site (trang tình nguyện trên trang Web của chúng ta) = Volunteer information (Thông tin tình nguyện).

questions.stem: Who are today's guests on the podcast?
questions.explanation:
92. - Dẫn chứng: "Today, I'll be interviewing the owners of Salazar Olive Oil, one of the best in California for the past two decades." (Hôm nay, tôi sẽ phỏng vấn các chủ sở hữu của Dầu ô liu Salazar, một trong những loại tốt nhất ở California trong hai thập kỷ qua.)
- Paraphrase: the owners of Salazar Olive Oil (các chủ sở hữu của Dầu ô liu Salazar) = Business owners (Chủ doanh nghiệp).

questions.stem: Why does the speaker say, “The Salazar family has kept the operation small”?

options.text: To indicate why a product is only sold online
To justify the high price of a product
To suggest that a company is having financial difficulties
To explain why a product is not well-known

questions.explanation:
93. - Dẫn chứng: "if you're hearing about this olive oil for the first time, you're not alone. The Salazar family has kept the operation small." (nếu bạn nghe về loại dầu ô liu này lần đầu tiên, bạn không đơn độc. Gia đình Salazar đã giữ cho hoạt động kinh doanh nhỏ.)
- Paraphrase: kept the operation small (giữ cho hoạt động kinh doanh nhỏ) = To explain why a product is not well-known (Để giải thích tại sao một sản phẩm không nổi tiếng).

questions.stem: What will the listeners be able to do after the podcast?
questions.explanation:
94. - Dẫn chứng: "an olive oil tasting class on their farm. You'll find out how to register during the interview so you can sign up!" (một lớp nếm dầu ô liu tại trang trại của họ. Bạn sẽ tìm ra cách đăng ký trong buổi phỏng vấn để bạn có thể đăng ký!)
- Paraphrase: sign up for a class (đăng ký một lớp học) = Sign up for a class (Đăng ký một lớp học).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, why was a transit route changed?

options.text: Some roads are closed for a bicycle race.
A group of residents is hosting a fund-raising concert.
A local politician will be speaking in a park.

questions.explanation:
95. - Dẫn chứng: "the Circle Route bus is not currently stopping at the station entrance because of some street resurfacing work." (xe buýt Tuyến Vòng tròn hiện không dừng ở lối vào nhà ga vì một số công việc trải lại mặt đường.)
- Paraphrase: street resurfacing work (công việc trải lại mặt đường) = Some streets are being resurfaced (Một số đường phố đang được trải lại mặt đường).

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Where will the listeners find a new bus stop?
questions.explanation:
96. - Dẫn chứng: "A temporary bus stop has been set up around the corner in front of the post office." (Một trạm xe buýt tạm thời đã được thiết lập ở góc phố phía trước bưu điện.)
- Paraphrase: in front of the post office (phía trước bưu điện) = On Peach Street (Trên phố Peach).

questions.stem: Why should the listeners check a mobile phone application?
questions.explanation:
97. - Dẫn chứng: "Use the Abingdon Transit mobile phone app to view live updates for when the next bus is due." (Sử dụng ứng dụng điện thoại di động Abingdon Transit để xem các cập nhật trực tiếp về thời điểm xe buýt tiếp theo đến.)
- Paraphrase: view live updates for when the next bus is due (xem các cập nhật trực tiếp về thời điểm xe buýt tiếp theo đến) = view bus schedule updates (xem các cập nhật lịch trình xe buýt).

questions.stem: Where does the speaker work?
questions.explanation:
98. - Dẫn chứng: "We're happy to announce that the February continuing education workshops here at the community center were very successful." (Chúng tôi vui mừng thông báo rằng các buổi hội thảo giáo dục thường xuyên tháng Hai tại trung tâm cộng đồng ở đây đã rất thành công.)
- Paraphrase: community center (trung tâm cộng đồng) = At a community center (Tại một trung tâm cộng đồng).

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Which workshop will be offered on Fridays starting in March?
questions.explanation:
99. - Dẫn chứng: "we had to create a waiting list for the Monday night workshop. Beginning in March, we'll offer that same workshop on Fridays." (chúng tôi đã phải tạo danh sách chờ cho buổi hội thảo tối thứ Hai. Bắt đầu từ tháng Ba, chúng tôi sẽ cung cấp buổi hội thảo đó vào các ngày thứ Sáu.)
- Paraphrase: Monday night workshop (buổi hội thảo tối thứ Hai) = Podcasting (Làm Podcast).

questions.stem: What will Bianca do next week?
questions.explanation:
100. - Dẫn chứng: "Bianca will be contacting vending services next week to ask about pricing." (Bianca sẽ liên hệ với các dịch vụ bán hàng tự động vào tuần tới để hỏi về giá cả.)
- Paraphrase: contacting vending services (liên hệ với các dịch vụ bán hàng tự động) = Contact some vendors (Liên hệ với một số nhà cung cấp).

questions.stem: The all-new Amore sports sedan is engineered for maximum reliability ------- gas mileage.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc song hành dùng liên từ and để nối hai danh từ/cụm danh từ "reliability" và "gas mileage", chỉ ra hai ưu điểm song song của chiếc xe.

questions.stem: The staff was grateful for the ------- that Mr. Schuller distributed at the meeting.
questions.explanation: Sau mạo từ the và trước mệnh đề quan hệ cần một danh từ làm tân ngữ. Information là danh từ không đếm được phù hợp nhất.

questions.stem: The next meeting of the planning committee will be held ------- at 2 P.M.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ promptly thường đi kèm với các mốc thời gian để nhấn mạnh sự đúng giờ (vào đúng lúc 2 giờ chiều).

questions.stem: Reimbursement for travel expenses will be included in ------- October 1 paycheck.
questions.explanation: Trước cụm danh từ "October 1 paycheck" cần một tính từ sở hữu để chỉ sự sở hữu của người nhận.

questions.stem: The ------- design engineer on the drone camera project is Iseul Bae.
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ lead design engineer (kỹ sư thiết kế chính) là cách dùng phổ biến để chỉ người đứng đầu về kỹ thuật trong một dự án.

questions.stem: After reading several reviews, Mr. Kim was able to decide which printer ------- for the office.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc decide which + noun + to-V dùng để chỉ sự lựa chọn thực hiện một hành động cụ thể.

questions.stem: Please remove the boxes left in the staff lounge ------- 5 P.M.
questions.explanation: Giới từ by dùng với mốc thời gian mang nghĩa là "trước hoặc chậm nhất là vào lúc đó".

questions.stem: The Southport ------- plant is expected to begin production in three days.
questions.explanation: Cần một tính từ hoặc danh động từ đóng vai trò tính từ bổ nghĩa cho "plant" (nhà máy). Manufacturing plant (nhà máy sản xuất) là cụm danh từ ghép phổ biến.

questions.stem: After accepting a job offer, a candidate must ------- all onboarding tasks before the start date.
questions.explanation: Động từ complete (hoàn thành) đi cùng với "tasks" (nhiệm vụ) là cách kết hợp từ tự nhiên nhất trong ngữ cảnh làm thủ tục nhận việc.

questions.stem: Although ------- training has just begun, Ms. Yu has already mastered the company's proprietary accounting software.
questions.explanation: Sau liên từ Although dẫn đầu một mệnh đề phụ, chúng ta cần một tính từ sở hữu đứng trước danh từ "training" để làm chủ ngữ.

questions.stem: Ms. Clayton was ------- to find that none of her files had been lost during the power failure.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc find that + clause. Tính từ relieved (an tâm/nhẹ nhõm) mô tả đúng cảm xúc của con người khi không bị mất dữ liệu sau sự cố.

questions.stem: During Mr. Nagahori's tenure as CEO at Unten Properties, the company has grown -------.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ grown (phát triển) cần một trạng từ để bổ nghĩa. Significantly (đáng kể) thường dùng để mô tả mức độ phát triển của công ty.

questions.stem: Safety must always be the top ------- in each step of the glassblowing process.
questions.explanation: Danh từ priority (sự ưu tiên) phù hợp nhất với ngữ cảnh về "an toàn" (Safety) trong một quy trình sản xuất nguy hiểm như thổi thủy tinh.

questions.stem: Central Science Museum hosts online seminars by experts who ------- topics related to information technology.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ who thay thế cho "experts" (số nhiều), nên động từ theo sau phải chia ở dạng nguyên thể cover để phù hợp với chủ ngữ số nhiều.

questions.stem: Conradia Computers ------- changed the direction of its marketing strategy last week.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ abruptly (đột ngột) bổ nghĩa cho động từ "changed", diễn tả sự thay đổi phương hướng một cách nhanh chóng và bất ngờ.

questions.stem: Because of an abundance of ------- candidates, Xaniper Industries may take longer than expected to name a new CEO.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ abundance of và trước danh từ candidates cần một tính từ. Qualified (đủ năng lực) là tính từ mô tả chính xác tình trạng của các ứng viên.

questions.stem: All of our tablet computers come with a one-year warranty ------- includes hardware repairs and replacements.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ that dùng để thay thế cho danh từ chỉ vật warranty và đóng vai trò chủ ngữ cho mệnh đề phía sau.

questions.stem: The Exprite Foundation Board of Directors is ------- of nine members who are elected annually by the public.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc be composed of mang nghĩa là "được bao gồm bởi" hoặc "được cấu thành từ", phù hợp để mô tả thành phần nhân sự của ban giám đốc.

questions.stem: Mortgage brokers generally prefer to review all the financial documents ------- meeting with a new client.
questions.explanation: Giới từ before đi với danh động từ (V-ing) để chỉ một mốc thời gian xảy ra trước một hành động khác.

questions.stem: Management ------- candidates for promotion by the end of the month.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ by the end of the month (vào cuối tháng) là dấu hiệu cho một hành động sẽ hoàn tất trong tương lai. Will identify là thì tương lai đơn phù hợp.

questions.stem: While we typically charge $25 for missed appointments, we understand that ------- circumstances may arise.
